name: Coforge Ltd.
business_summary: Mid-cap digital-engineering IT services firm focused on travel/transport, BFSI and insurance, with North America ~50% and EMEA ~30%. Revenue stepped up ~50% YoY after a large acquisition completed in Q1 FY27 (Encora per model knowledge; not re-verified). Q2 FY27 (2026-10-23): PAT Rs588 cr, order book +45%, EBIT margin guide raised to 16%. Stock +62% in six months, P/E 42.5. Governance event on 2026-09-09: chairman O.P. Bhatt resigned after a board-evaluation dispute; Akhil Gupta appointed chair 2026-09-29.

exposures.mechanism: ~92% foreign-currency revenue; INR ~ 38% of costs after the large acquisition (model knowledge). +3% USD/INR => ~+1.2pp EBITDA margin on 20% = +6% EBITDA pre-hedge; persistence 0.35; EV/MCap 1.1 (acquisition debt) => +2.3, shaded to +2.0. Pack USDINR sensitivity not in its top-12 list.

evidence.note: Screener: Sep-26 qtr sales 6,171 cr, OPM 20%, PAT 605 cr, P/E 42.5, 6m +62%

exposures.mechanism: North America ~ 50% of revenue pre-acquisition, higher now (model knowledge). +1pp US growth => revenue +0.8%; incremental margin 30% vs 20% => EBITDA +1.2%; mid-cap growth multiple (P/E 42.5) amplifies: persistence 1.0, EV/MCap 1.1 => ~+2.6. Pack S&P elasticity +2.93 (t +2.6) supports high US-sentiment beta.
